summary.en: USB fingerprint enrolment and RFID card-issuing reader for a compatible management workstation. Register users at the desk rather than at each entrance.

summary.en: Outdoor fingerprint and RFID reader for a compatible access-control system. Useful at staff entrances where a separate controller manages the door.

value.en: IP65; installation and cable entry must maintain sealing
value.sw: IP65; ufungaji na nyaya lazima vihifadhi ulinzi
RS485; hutegemea controller na firmware

value.sw: Rejea ya eneo ya Silk ID; toleo jipya la Z-ID lina tofauti

compatibility.en: This regional image/reference describes the Silk ID generation. Newer FR1500S revisions have different sensor, power and protocol specifications. Confirm the exact SKU and controller pairing; IP65 does not mean submersible.

summary.en: Handheld wired scanner for retail counters, stores and compatible business applications. Reads supported 1D barcodes and 2D codes including QR.

value.sw: USB 2.0
Kubonyeza trigger au usomaji wa moja kwa moja

value.en: 1D and 2D, including QR and Data Matrix
value.sw: 1D na 2D, zikiwemo QR na Data Matrix

compatibility.en: A POS/data-capture peripheral, not a fingerprint or access reader. Confirm code formats, application input and workstation compatibility; no POS or ERP integration is included by default.

summary.en: Wheeled under-vehicle mirror with an LED light for visual checks at controlled entrances. A practical aid for a trained security team.
summary.sw: Kioo chenye magurudumu na taa ya LED kwa ukaguzi wa chini ya magari kwenye malango. Husaidia walinzi waliopewa mafunzo.

value.sw: Kipenyo 300mm
Mpini 1200–1400mm
Ukaguzi wa macho unaofanywa na mtu; taa ya LED

compatibility.en: A manual visual aid, not an automatic scanner, explosive detector or guarantee of detection. Confirm included light and battery requirements and train operators in a site-specific inspection procedure.
compatibility.sw: Ni msaada wa ukaguzi wa macho, si scanner ya moja kwa moja, detector ya vilipuzi wala hakikisho la kugundua kila kitu. Hakiki taa, betri na mafunzo ya utaratibu wa ukaguzi wa eneo.

summary.en: Dual-energy baggage X-ray system for professionally planned screening points at hotels, institutions and transport facilities. Requires specialist assessment and trained operation.
summary.sw: Mfumo wa X-ray wa kukagua mizigo kwa maeneo yaliyopangwa kitaalamu kama hoteli, taasisi na vituo vya usafiri. Unahitaji tathmini maalumu na waendeshaji waliofunzwa.

value.sw: X-ray ya dual-energy; interface ya TCP/IP

value.en: Space, power, training and local approvals assessed separately
value.sw: Nafasi, umeme, mafunzo na vibali vya eneo hutathminiwa tofauti

compatibility.en: Not a metal-detector wand or medical scanner. Availability, model revision, installation, radiation-safety requirements, approvals and specialist support must be confirmed before quotation; no licensing or specialist certification is implied.
compatibility.sw: Si detector ya chuma ya mkononi wala scanner ya kitabibu. Upatikanaji, toleo, ufungaji, usalama wa mionzi, vibali na msaada wa kitaalamu lazima vithibitishwe kabla ya nukuu; hatudai leseni au vyeti maalumu.

summary.en: Vehicle barrier with a folding boom and LED indication for access lanes with height constraints. Plan the lane, controls and pedestrian route together.
summary.sw: Kizuizi cha magari chenye mkono unaokunjika na alama za LED kwa njia zenye nafasi ndogo ya juu. Panga njia, controls na njia ya watembea kwa miguu kwa pamoja.

value.sw: Mkono unaokunjika wenye LED
Familia ya vizuizi vinavyotumia servo motor

value.en: Reader/controller and safety devices selected separately
value.sw: Reader/controller na vifaa vya usalama huchaguliwa tofauti

compatibility.en: Confirm boom length, duty requirements, safety sensors, vehicle detection and emergency operation. RFID or remote controls are not assumed to be included; installation depends on site assessment.
compatibility.sw: Hakiki urefu wa mkono, matumizi, sensors za usalama, utambuzi wa magari na matumizi wakati wa dharura. RFID au remotes hazidhaniwi kujumuishwa; ufungaji hutegemea tathmini ya eneo.

summary.en: Compact handheld metal detector for controlled-entry screening by trained personnel. Visual indicators and selectable alerts support a clear inspection routine.
summary.sw: Detector ndogo ya chuma ya mkononi kwa ukaguzi wa watu unaofanywa na walinzi waliofunzwa. Ina viashiria vya mwanga na chaguo za tahadhari.

value.sw: Sauti + mwanga au mtetemo + mwanga

value.en: 9V rechargeable battery reference; confirm supplied kit
value.sw: Rejea ya betri inayochajiwa ya 9V; hakiki vifaa vilivyojumuishwa

compatibility.en: A metal detector, not a detector for all prohibited items or a magnetic-stripe card reader. Detection depends on object, orientation and operator procedure. Confirm charger/battery and demonstrate settings at handover.
compatibility.sw: Ni detector ya chuma, si ya kila kitu kilichokatazwa wala kisomaji cha kadi ya magnetic stripe. Ugunduzi hutegemea kitu, mwelekeo na utaratibu wa ukaguzi. Hakiki charger/betri na pewa maelekezo wakati wa makabidhiano.
